abstract.para: Wireshark is an open source network protocol analyzer used for network troubleshooting, analysis, software and communications protocol development and education. Because Wireshark parses a wide array of complex network protocols, it frequently receives updates for security vulnerabilities (CVEs) and protocol support.

listitem.para: Balanced. This balances strict stability with timely security patching and protocol analysis capabilities.

Delivered continuously within &suselinux; 16 minor releases and for previously released minor releases in maintenance. They contain security fixes and bug repairs only, with no new or changed features.
Updated with a &suselinux; 16 minor release when a new upstream stable branch is selected for &suselinux;. Such updates can introduce new protocol dissectors and features.
When upstream releases a new major version, &suse; evaluates case by case whether to transition. Any transition is documented in the release notes.
